description: An addition branch in eval_BinOp that raises a type error when an operand is not an int. The comment marks this branch as often untested.

steps.description: This is `eval_BinOp`, an example of an error path that often stays red in coverage. The page lists error recovery paths as a common blind spot after running coverage on a typical Mini interpreter.
It evaluates the left and right operands into `left` and `right`.
For `+`, it checks that both operands are ints. If either is not, it raises `LangTypeError`; the comment marks that branch as often untested. Otherwise it returns `left + right`.
